We’re excited to announce a new evolution in our Paymaster services:

ThePaymaster® is now partnered with a regulated OTC desk. This unlocks powerful capabilities for our clients:

✅ Buy or sell large-scale crypto without limits imposed by everyday exchanges

✅ Payout in fiat or crypto — your choice

✅ Streamlined compliance — giving your bank a perfect audit trail

But here’s the real value: Most crypto deals fall apart not at the start… but at the end. When it’s time to convert to fiat, banks often freeze or reject funds due to compliance gaps.

We fix that — proactively!
